# Manifest REST API

Agent-readable resources for integrating with the Manifest public REST API.

- [API reference](https://manifeststartup.com/docs/api)
- [OpenAPI 3.1 document](https://manifeststartup.com/openapi.json)
- [Agent guide](https://manifeststartup.com/agents.md) (authentication and scoped API-key use)
- [API tier pricing and limits](https://manifeststartup.com/pricing.md)
- [RFC 9727 API catalog](https://manifeststartup.com/.well-known/api-catalog)
